not_ready_reason: V2 §10.6 -- a handoff is not Stage-24-ready until 23.2G confirms Role A on untouched evidence. 23.2G has not been executed.

corrected_confirmatory_hypothesis.name: depth_complete_nuisance_control
corrected_confirmatory_hypothesis.statement: Under the historical Rewind outcome and the frozen Stage-22/23 evaluation geometry, pretreatment transcriptional state predicts the Role-A outcome beyond a DEPTH-COMPLETE nuisance baseline Bdepth = [log1p(n_pretreatment_cells), n_lanes, log1p(total_raw_GE_UMI), log1p(n_detected_GE_features_in_raw_pseudobulk)].
corrected_confirmatory_hypothesis.why_mechanical: RESIDUAL_DEPTH_STRUCTURE is the only SUPPORTED mechanism that implies a correction. MODEL_SELECTION_NULL_INFLATION is UNRESOLVED, so search matching is not indicated; OUTCOME_LABEL_LIMITATION is UNRESOLVED, so V2 §8.7 forbids adopting an alternative outcome. The correction was not chosen by effect size.
corrected_confirmatory_hypothesis.outcome: historical hard label, top-100 gDNA barcodes with ties, unchanged
corrected_confirmatory_hypothesis.search: the frozen historical K x C grid, unchanged

role_a.outcome_version: historical top-100 gDNA barcode label with ties, 35 positive clones of 3,147; unchanged by Stage 23.2

primary_metric_and_gate.gate: observed > null p95 AND p_perm <= 0.05 under the frozen permutation design, on untouched confirmation evidence

minimum_design_requirement.do_not_interpolate: the ladder is coarse (35 / 70 / 140 positive clones). The requirement is the smallest TESTED cohort reaching 0.80, not an interpolated value between rungs -- V2 §9.5 forbids extrapolating a precise required N.

global.exact_stage_24_opening_rule: Stage 24 opens only on ROLE_A_CONFIRMATORY_SUPPORTED from 23.2G -- a pre-registered confirmatory analysis succeeding on evidence not used to design the correction -- together with a complete, benchmark-compatible handoff. Role B positives cannot substitute for it without an explicit roadmap revision.
